d:
Enjoy The Beautiful Evergreen Kannada Melody “Neenello Naanalle” From The Classic Kannada Movie Chalisuva Modagalu, Featuring Dr. Rajkumar, Ambika, And Saritha. Music Composed By The Legendary Rajan-Nagendra, This Timeless Song Brings Back The Golden Memories Of Kannada Cinema.
Enjoy This Evergreen Kannada Song And Celebrate The Golden Era Of Sandalwood Music.
Directed by: Singeetham Srinivasa Rao
Produced by: Parvathamma Rajkumar
Written by: Singeetham Srinivasa Rao (Dialogues by Chi. Udayashankar)
Artist Name: Rajkumar, Ambika, Saritha, Puneeth Rajkumar
Music Director: Rajan-Nagendra
